items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: Yeah, I played with Alphonse Picoult. We played a concert out at Xavier Prep, Xavier College out here.

ctx.x: We must see him some of these days, I've never met him.

Yeah, he's a little slender brown-skinned fellow. He's a former postal employee, he's retired now. And you say you played with Picoult. Yeah, I played with Alphonse Picoult. We played a concert out at Xavier Prep, Xavier College out here. Oh, yeah. And I played a few dance jobs, but there don't be many of them no more. Mostly brass bands. Mostly brass bands. They had the dance work, well, it'll be all right. Look like the people don't go for it, they just go for those boxes. Yeah. Arthur Follett's.
Oh, to change the subject, do you have any favorite trombone of all the different people you've heard any place in the country? Who do you like?
